narratives.text: Revenues 由 FY2024 的 7,441.00 上升至 FY2025 的 7,647.00。依CF-09計算成長率為 2.77%。管理階層指出，銷量與收購帶動平均每日銷售額增加 4.8%，但 FY2025 比 FY2024 少一週，全年營收成長為 2.8%。
Gross profit margin 由 FY2024 的 26.61% 上升至 FY2025 的 26.93%。變動 0.32 個百分點。管理階層指出，毛利改善措施及採購、定價紀律，使毛利率由 26.6% 提高至 26.9%。
Operating profit margin 由 FY2024 的 9.66% 下降至 FY2025 的 9.44%。變動 -0.22 個百分點。毛利增加 USD 79m，但 SG&A 增加 USD 76m，來自收購、人員薪酬福利、配送成本與科技投入，營業利益僅增加 USD 3m。
Interest expense 由 FY2024 的 142.00 下降至 FY2025 的 120.00。管理階層指出，前一年度定期貸款利差修訂、較低利率及 ABL 借款減少，使利息費用由 USD 142m 降至 120m。
Pre-tax profit margin 由 FY2024 的 7.75% 上升至 FY2025 的 7.94%。變動 0.18 個百分點。營業利益僅增加 USD 3m；利息費用減少 USD 22m，有助稅前利益由 USD 577m 升至 607m。稅率變動不作為稅前利益率的原因。

notes.text: FY2023 截至 2024-01-28；FY2024 截至 2025-02-02（53 週）；FY2025 截至 2026-02-01（52 週）。FY2022 僅為系統年度格式的參考基期。淨利採合併淨利、包含非控制權益；EBITDA 使用現金流量表完整 D&A，避免與損益表 D&A 重複加計。

narratives.text: Current ratio 由 FY2024 的 233.83% 上升至 FY2025 的 263.39%。所選來源輸入未附可核實的原因證據，本段僅作數值比較。
Cash flow ratio 由 FY2024 的 71.71% 上升至 FY2025 的 74.37%。管理階層指出，現金利息與現金所得稅各減少 USD 64m，加上較高淨利，使營業現金流增至 USD 650m；較高營運資金占用部分抵銷改善。
Debt ratio 由 FY2024 的 230.89% 下降至 FY2025 的 193.39%。所選來源輸入未附可核實的原因證據，本段僅作數值比較。

notes.text: 速動資產採現金加淨額客戶應收帳款的保守口徑，未納入供應商回饋應收款。FY2025 客戶應收款 USD 981m、供應商回饋 USD 67m，合計財報應收款 USD 1,048m。

narratives.text: LTM EBITDA 由 FY2024 的 913.00 上升至 FY2025 的 919.00。所選來源輸入未附可核實的原因證據，本段僅作數值比較。

reviewed-passage:operations.content: Net sales for fiscal 2025 increased $206 million, or 2.8%, to $7,647 million compared with $7,441 million for fiscal 2024. Net sales increased primarily due to a 4.8% increase in average daily net sales driven by higher volumes and acquisitions partially offset by one less selling week compared to prior year. Average daily net sales increased for pipes, valves & fittings, storm drainage and meters primarily due to higher volumes and acquisitions. Average daily net sales increased for fire protection products primarily due to higher average selling prices and acquisitions. (“Core & Main”) is a Delaware corporation that was incorporated on April 9, 2021 for the purpose of facilitating an initial public offering and other related transactions, as described below, in order to carry on the business of Core & Main Holdings, LP, a Delaware limited partnership (“Holdings”), and its consolidated subsidiaries. Core & Main is a holding company and its primary material asset is its ownership interest in Holdings, a portion of which is held indirectly through CD&R WW, LLC. Core & Main, together with its wholly-owned subsidiaries, including Holdings and its consolidated subsidiaries, are referred to as the “Company”. The Company is a leader in advancing reliable infrastructure with local service, nationwide. As a leading specialized distributor with a focus on water, wastewater, storm drainage and fire protection products and related services, the Company provides solutions to municipalities, private water companies and professional contractors across municipal, non-residential and residential end markets, nationwide. The Company’s specialty products and services are used in the maintenance, repair, replacement, and construction of water and fire protection infrastructure. The Company reaches customers through a nationwide network of approximately 320 branches across 48 states. Initial Public Offering On July 27, 2021, Core & Main completed its initial public offering of 34,883,721 shares of Class A common stock at a price to the public of $ 20.00 per share (the “IPO”).
